text_block_list.text:
One day, a sudden downpour struck without 
any warning from the weather forecast.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...It's a proper downpour, isn't it? Now 
then, what to do—

I bumped into Symboli Rudolf, who was lost 
in thought about something.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing. The truth is, 
embarrassing as it is to admit... I find 
myself with too much time on my hands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Due to this torrential rain, the Student 
Council's scheduled field duties had to be 
pushed back."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then I thought I'd get ahead on other 
work—only to find Air Groove had beaten me 
to the punch.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She finished up all the remaining work, 
too. Good grief, she really is 
exceptional.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Well, thanks to that— as you can see, 
I've ended up with time on my hands."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's because my life is always 
packed with schedules. Getting troubled at 
a time like this shows my own 
shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: “—Oh, is that all? It was that simple?”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii♪ You seemed unusually troubled, so I 
couldn't help eavesdropping from the 
shadows♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. As always, you have quite the 
sharp ear for other people's troubles.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And so— What is this 'simple thing'?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Abso-tootly-lutely. It's the 'what to do 
with free time' dilemma♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"If you can't decide what to do, just go 
ahead and do the first thing that comes to 
mind!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"A sudden thought, was it— So quick-witted 
and adaptable."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... I-Is that what you'd call it? 
Stiff as ever, I see...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, if even Rudolph is having a hard 
time coming up with ideas—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's already someone right here who 
could think of something for you♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'll leave the rest to you two 
young lovebirds! This passing big sis is 
gonna say bye-bee~♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Young" or not, aren't they in the same 
grade...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I understood what they were 
trying to say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. Forgive me, but could you 
lend me your wisdom?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"What should we do with all this free 
time? I'd like to hear your suggestion to 
break through my perplexity."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see. Indeed, this might be a 
once-in-a-lifetime opportunity...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. I'm terribly sorry to ask 
again, but could you spare me some time 
after this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would like to share a gem of a joke that 
I've saved in the notebook I always carry 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my improvement, I want 
your frank and unvarnished opinion...!

"After that, I ended up having to endure a 
rapid-fire barrage of Symboli Rudolf's 
jokes."

It was a strange time that's hard to put 
into words... but it seemed to have been 
meaningful for her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Polishing yourself at every given 
opportunity, are you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As fellow travelers on this path, I cannot 
fail to answer that ambition.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, let's head to the 
trainer's office. We can study footage of 
past races in the rain.

Afterward, Symboli Rudolf and I studied 
video footage of rainy races from start to 
finish.
